overview.description: The Northern Trust iBoxx 3-Year Target Duration TIPS ETF (TDTT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the iBoxx 3-Year Target Duration TIPS index. The fund tracks an index of inflation-protected US government debt with maturity dates of 1-10 years. TDTT was launched on Sep 19, 2011 and is issued by Northern Trust.
